headline: Alibaba beats Q3 revenue expectations on 53% surge in AI cloud services
summary: Alibaba Group reported quarterly revenue above analyst expectations, boosted by a 53% jump in AI cloud and computing service sales. Net profit was further supported by investment performance gains.
why: Alibaba is China's largest e-commerce and cloud computing corporation by total domestic market share.

impacts.name: Alibaba
impacts.why: Revenue exceeded market forecasts due to strong demand for cloud computing and AI services.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong performance in Alibaba's AI cloud unit drove quarterly revenue past consensus market targets.
